decision: RETIRE THE K2 ROW AS AN INVALID ATTEMPT; THE HYPOTHESIS IS UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED; CLOSE THE K SEARCH.
reading: The one block produced no admissible comparison. It is not evidence for or against the K2 hypothesis, and it may not be cited as a failed replication or as a null result.
consequences: K2 leaves in-test and no second K2 block is authorised.
No seventh task family is added.
Future constraint registrations use a same-build comparator.
The in-test slot is free for the K1 forced-selection arm.
